description: This file declares classes and structures related to a port-based channel estimator for wireless communication systems, including configuration, DM-RS pattern specification, and results access.

classes.name: port_channel_estimator
classes.description: Abstract class for estimating the channel for one receive antenna port based on DM-RS symbols.

classes.name: port_channel_estimator_results
classes.description: Interface for accessing estimated channel coefficients and metrics such as EPRE, SNR, RSRP, CFO, and time alignment.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Calculates the channel estimate given a resource grid, port, pilots, and configuration.

methods.name: get_symbol_ch_estimate
methods.description: Retrieves the estimated channel coefficients for a specific OFDM symbol and transmission layer.

methods.name: get_symbol_ch_estimate (with re_mask)
methods.description: Retrieves the estimated channel coefficients for specific REs within an OFDM symbol, as specified by a mask.

methods.name: get_epre
methods.description: Returns the estimated EPRE (Effective Power Ratio Estimate).

methods.name: get_snr
methods.description: Returns the estimated SNR (Signal-to-Noise Ratio) in linear scale.

methods.name: get_rsrp
methods.description: Returns the estimated RSRP (Reference Signal Received Power) for a given transmission layer.

methods.name: get_cfo_Hz
methods.description: Returns the estimated carrier frequency offset in Hz, if computable.

methods.name: get_time_alignment
methods.description: Returns the estimated time alignment in PHY time units.
